system.description:
This Spell can create and destroy fresh water in the following ways:

Area: The space within is emptied or filled with water. If the area is occupied by a Being, this requires a Cast Check. You choose if this water remains or dries up after the duration.

Target: This can push an Item that occupies 1 or fewer Slots, or a Being with Level or HD 1 or lower. You can upcast this Spell to increase this number by 1 per Mana spent to do so.

Distance: This pushes the Target 5', and you can upcast this Spell to increase the distance pushed by 5' per Mana spent to do so.
